The live configuration matches the committed template for memory, timeout, environment variables and concurrency (no reserved concurrency anywhere). Two suspicious commits, 24f3656 (CrudApi TABLE_NAME set to 'missing-table') and 44a967f (Thumbnailer OUTPUT_BUCKET set to 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca'), were both reverted (ca30e64, c5cd710) before the window, and the live values and HEAD template are correct. The last config changes (Thumbnailer 01:56:27Z, CrudApi 23:50:12Z) predate the window and are consistent with the template. No IAM or code change falls in the window.
